title: SL-01 (SLPRS)
description:
Background: Designed by Ye and Mats Rombaut, this would be Ye's 2nd piece of Footwear after his split from Adidas. Ye showed sketches and development of the SL-01 on his Instagram story after releasing them.

Released under a YZY GOSHA Collection in January 2025, the SL-01 became a basic shoe that would continue into SZNX. 

Yeezy would release the Black SL-01 in person at a Mexico Pop Up on 02/07/2026 for $50.
